items.name: Brown Pelican Carolina Coast Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Ivory tee printed on the chest with a lifelike painted brown pelican perched on a wooden piling, hanging from a weathered dock rail beside a rope-wrapped piling on the Carolina coast, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a lifelike painted brown pelican on a wooden piling, a Carolina Beach coast favorite. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Pelican illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
